scripts.serve: npm run build:frontend && node scripts/run_jekyll.mjs serve --livereload
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:jekyll
scripts.test:unit: tsc --project tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && node --test build/tests/tests/posts/model.test.js tests/posts/app.integration.test.mjs tests/search/site-search.integration.test.mjs tests/tools/results.integration.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run test:frontmatter && npm run test:site-validator && npm run build:frontend
scripts.verify: npm test && npm run build:jekyll && npm run verify:frontmatter && npm run test:integration && python3 scripts/verify_site.py
